commentary.headline: The latest Eurostat household electricity-price release is 2025-S2. Greece is broadly aligned with the EU27 benchmark in Band DC in PPS terms.
commentary.affordability: Greece ranks 16th in nominal EUR terms but 11th in PPS terms, indicating a heavier affordability burden after adjusting for purchasing power.
commentary.typical_household: Greece is broadly aligned with the EU27 benchmark in Band DC in PPS terms.
commentary.taxes: For Band DC, the tax-inclusive PPS price in Greece is about 21.9% above the tax-exclusive level.
commentary.trend: The trend section should be read as a convergence/divergence signal: the important question is whether Greece is moving toward or away from the EU27 benchmark over time.
commentary.momentum: Greek Band DC electricity prices increased +2.7% year on year. Across the wider sample, Romania recorded the largest increase (+51.5%), while Turkey recorded the largest decline (-15.7%).
